intro: You're moderating the comments on a livestream. Comments fly in fast, and they get faster every round. Tap any comment with a fallacy to hide it. Leave the reasonable ones up, even if you don't like them: disagreeing isn't a fallacy.

episodes.title: Live: Will AI Take Our Jobs?

c.t: Some jobs will disappear and new ones will show up, like with every new technology.
Anyone defending AI is obviously getting paid by the tech companies.
I use it for design work and it speeds me up.
AI is dangerous because it isn't safe, and it isn't safe because it's dangerous.
Everyone's scared of it, so it's definitely going to destroy us.
We need rules for how it's used.
So you want to stop progress and go back to the Stone Age?
The main thing is learning to use it well.
Either we let it do everything or we ban it completely.
Some jobs need a human touch that won't be easy to replace.
